approach: Fix the display and instruction. Add a producer-only "Report criteria_check" section to producer_brief in briefs.rs. It lists each criterion as a bare verbatim line to copy, and tells the producer to write one criteria_check entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including criteria already satisfied. Add one short pointer sentence to the change producer.md. Shorten the shared producer.md criteria_check line so it does not grow and does not contradict the brief. Reword the CriterionCheckOutput docs in outputs.rs. Align the send-back wording in run.rs; matching stays unchanged. Tests for send-back go in a new #[cfg(test)] module inside run.rs (a listed deliverable), not in run_pin_tests.rs. Record the cause, alternatives and measured or estimated rates in docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md.

decisions.choice: Add a verbatim copyable criteria list and an explicit one-entry-per-criterion instruction to the producer brief only; keep the numbered list for cross-reference.
decisions.reason: Copying removes the retyping that makes wording drift. The brief is not token-budgeted like the shared prompt, and planner briefs stay unchanged.

rejected.why: The shared prompt is at 1276/1300 tokens, and without a copyable form the model still retypes from memory.
Field docs are short, are read less than the brief, and cannot supply the exact text.
It could accept a different criterion as met and hides the drift instead of fixing it.

decisions.choice: Shorten, never lengthen, the criteria_check line in the shared producer.md.
decisions.reason: It is a listed deliverable, but the budget forbids growth, and its 'no number or kind tag' wording must not conflict with the brief.

rejected.why: The wording conflicts with the copy-the-line instruction.

decisions.choice: Put the new run.rs tests in a #[cfg(test)] module inside run.rs, not in run_pin_tests.rs.
decisions.reason: This answers finding 2: run.rs is a listed deliverable and run_pin_tests.rs is not, so scope stays within the deliverables. run.rs has no tests module today.

rejected.why: It is outside the listed deliverables and would widen scope.

decisions.choice: Leave the matching in run.rs unchanged. Change only the send-back wording and add tests.
decisions.reason: Matching is not the root cause, and the send-back already names the exact text.

rejected.option: Send-back lists every criterion with its status
rejected.why: Out of scope, and it does not reduce first-report misses.

files.purpose: Add the producer-only criteria_check section with a verbatim copyable list and the instruction. Add tests.
Add one short sentence pointing to the brief's criteria_check section.
Shorten the criteria_check line so it does not grow or contradict the brief.
Reword the CriterionCheckOutput docs: copy the line from the brief.
Align the send-back wording and add a #[cfg(test)] module for unmet_criteria and the send-back text. Matching unchanged.
Record the cause, the alternatives and the before/after rates with sources.

steps: Read the available job records for the six jobs. Count first-run send-backs and their causes, and note what is unreadable.
Edit briefs.rs: add the producer-only criteria_check section with bare verbatim lines and the instruction, plus unit tests.
Add the one sentence to the change producer.md. Shorten the shared producer.md line. Reword the outputs.rs docs.
Align the send-back wording in run.rs and add the #[cfg(test)] module with the complete-report and omitted-criterion tests.
Write the decisions.md note and the CHANGELOG.md entry.
Run cargo test, the budgets test, cargo fmt and cargo clippy --all-targets.

risks.risk: The shared producer.md budget (1276/1300) is exceeded.
risks.mitigation: Only shorten that file, and run the budgets test.

risks.risk: Changing the brief breaks planner brief tests.
risks.mitigation: Add the section in producer_brief only. Keep the numbered list.

risks.risk: The before rate is thin or unreadable.
risks.mitigation: State the sample size and label each number measured or estimate. Invent nothing.

risks.risk: A model can still skip a criterion.
risks.mitigation: The note says the fix is measured only on later jobs, and gives a repeatable way to count send-backs.

demonstrations.observes: The note names display (numbered, tagged list), the prompt line and the 'without its number or kind tag' field doc as contributors. It cites run.rs unmet_criteria and criterion_key, briefs.rs reading_sections, both producer prompts and outputs.rs CriterionCheckOutput. It lists prompt only, schema only and tolerant matching as alternatives.

demonstrations.method: Read the rates section of the diff.
demonstrations.observes: One before rate for each of kb23, c2h3, 7qht, 0qcy, c4w4 and skh5, with the records read. Each is marked measured or estimate, with its sample size. Unreadable records are named. The after rate is given, or the note says no jobs have run since the change.

demonstrations.method: A new unit test in briefs.rs builds a producer brief from a reading with several criteria. It asserts each criterion text appears as its own bare line with no number or tag, in order. It asserts the brief instructs one criteria_check entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including already-satisfied criteria. It also asserts the planner brief does not contain the section.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old brief, which has only '1. [kind] text', the bare-line assertion and the 'one entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including satisfied' assertion both fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the budgets test, then inspect git diff for the prompt files.
demonstrations.observes: The budgets test passes. The shared producer.md diff is a net shortening. verifier.md has no diff. The new instructions are only in the change producer.md and briefs.rs.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the shared producer.md or the change verifier.md grew past its budget, the budgets test would fail.

demonstrations.method: A new tests module in run.rs. Test (a) calls unmet_criteria with a met entry for every criterion and expects an empty result. Test (b) omits one criterion and expects exactly that criterion's exact text, and that the send-back message built from it contains that text. If the existing harness can drive a full run, also assert exactly one send-back.
demonstrations.observes: (a) gives no unmet criteria and so no send-back. (b) gives one unmet entry, and the message contains the exact criterion text.
demonstrations.fails_without: If unmet_criteria ignored a missing entry, or the send-back text omitted the criterion's exact text, the omitted-criterion assertions would fail. If a complete report were sent back, the complete-report assertion would fail.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check in turn.
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0 with no warnings and no formatting diff, including the new tests in athena-context and athena-core.
demonstrations.fails_without: A failing new test, a clippy warning (for example an unused item or needless allocation in the new brief code) or unformatted code would make cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets or cargo fmt --check fail, so the change would not be accepted.

open_questions: The records of the six named jobs are not in this snapshot. The before rate may have to be reported as unmeasured.
Whether any test covers brief token size. The budgets test seems to cover prompt files only; I have not read it.
Whether the existing send-back message is built by a function that run.rs tests can call directly.
